newsitem.title: POLAND: One hurt in train crash on Polish-German border.
newsitem.headline: One hurt in train crash on Polish-German border.

text.p: One person was injured on Thursday when a Moscow-Berlin passenger train hit the back of a stationary freight train at Kunowice on the Polish-German border, a Polish railway spokeswoman said.

Alicja Bialobrzeska of the Polish State Railways press office told Reuters the passenger train's engine caught fire, two wagons of the freight train were destroyed and one passenger carriage was damaged.
"At four o'clock in the morning the passenger train from Moscow to Berlin hit the back of a freight train standing in Kunowice. One person was injured and taken to hospital," Bialobrzeska said.
She gave no further details and declined to comment on the cause of the accident, which disrupted regular train traffic in Kunowice for an hour.
